differences: The paper describes 28 runners (Subject numbers 1 to 28); the current figshare version holds 39, so the paper's participant count and demographic table do not apply to this release. Table 1 of the paper lists 48 markers, but 20 of them are anatomical markers removed after the standing calibration; the running files hold 32 markers (96 coordinate columns), so the table's marker count was not used as a check. The 2.5 and 4.5 m/s trials exist for only 31 of the 39 runners.
